author: wtranslator

sections.description:
WTranslator is an AI-powered WordPress Translation Plugin that helps you translate your WordPress website and make it multilingual with minimal setup. Supporting 248+ languages, WTranslator enables businesses, bloggers, publishers, and WooCommerce stores to connect with audiences worldwide. The free version provides instant visitor-side translation, while paid plans create crawlable, indexable, and SEO-ready translated pages.

This WordPress Translation Plugin combines automatic translation with manual editing, giving you the speed of neural AI translation and control over important content. You can quickly add a customizable language switcher, translate your website without coding, and upgrade when you need advanced multilingual SEO and translation management.

Unlike traditional translation plugins that store and process everything on your WordPress server, WTranslator’s paid plans use a cloud-based Translation Delivery Network (TDN). Translated pages are cached and delivered through the WTranslator cloud, helping your original website remain lightweight and responsive.

Paid plans include search-engine-friendly language URLs, translated URL slugs, hreflang tags, translated metadata, multilingual indexing, an in-context translation editor, translation memory, WooCommerce support, and language hosting. WTranslator does not limit the number of translated words or translated pageviews on paid plans, and automatic translations are included without additional usage charges.

With WTranslator, you can launch a multilingual WordPress website, improve international search visibility, and create more opportunities to grow global traffic, engagement, and sales.

If you have, just contact us through the support email.

How to Set Up WTranslator Plugin:
sections.installation:
Getting Started is Easy:

  1. Install WTranslator from your WordPress dashboard (Plugins → Add New → Search “WTranslator”)
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings → WTranslator
  4. Choose which languages you want to offer
  5. Pick your language switcher style (dropdown or flags)
  6. Save and you’re done!

Your visitors will now see a language switcher on your site and can choose their preferred language.
sections.faq:
Do I need to translate my content manually?

No! WTranslator uses Google Translate to translate your content when visitors view the site in another language. Activate the plugin, choose your languages, and content is translated for visitors on demand.

How many languages can I offer?

You can enable as many languages as you want from our list of 100+ supported languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Chinese, Japanese, Arabic, Russian, and many more.

Will my visitors’ language choice be remembered?

Yes! When a visitor selects a language, WTranslator remembers their choice so they don’t have to select it again on their next visit.

Does this slow down my website?

The plugin adds a small script and style bundle. Page HTML is still served by WordPress as usual; translation work happens in the visitor’s browser when they choose another language, similar to using Google Translate in the browser.

Can visitors switch back to the original language?

Absolutely! The language switcher always shows all available languages, so visitors can easily switch back and forth.

Do I need technical knowledge to use this?

Not at all! WTranslator is designed to be simple. Just install, choose your languages, and it works automatically.

Does the plugin send data to WTranslator?

Only if you opt in. By default nothing is sent to our servers. If you enable optional usage sharing, we receive anonymous site details (site URL, site name, plugin/WordPress/PHP versions, and locale). You may optionally also share the WordPress admin email. Translation features work fully without sharing. You can change or revoke this anytime under Settings → WTranslator → Privacy.
